budget.tokenizer: Measure actual provider tokens separately; bytes are not a token estimate.

corpusExpansion.noiseText: Paint swatch register: the neutral gray rectangle has a smooth border and an unmarked reverse.
corpusExpansion.purpose: Materialize 1001 newer rows of each personal type before every required older record; verify actual first-page cap and live production search. Noise is unrelated to every question; record selector pools must still be produced without gold filtering.

steps: Create two ordinary accounts. Establish an account-A session, revoke it, then sign in again on the same account; retain both request credentials separately.
Seed all evidence and personal chunks, including later-deleted and other-account records. Source rows are added only to their declared account library.
Delete each personal row with lifecycle.record=user_deleted using its owning ordinary account after indexing.
Soft-withdraw each source content item with lifecycle.source=withdrawn after indexing. Keep owned personal captures on that item.

rubric.direct: Contains the requested fact, event, instruction or interpretation for the specified entity, time and authorship. A current editorial claim requires a current source segment. A personal claim requires the relevant stored personal field.
rubric.equivalent: Contains the same requested fact with the same entity, time and authorship; allowed only when explicitly predeclared in eligibleIds.
rubric.complementary: Related advice that needs an unstated inferential bridge. Excluded unless the actual question explicitly requests that additional facet and it was labeled before acquisition.
rubric.irrelevant: A glossary mention, title match, wrong entity, matching prompt with unrelated answer, or adjacent procedure that does not itself supply the requested fact.
rubric.forbidden: Excluded by actual requested scope, ownership/library membership, deletion, source withdrawal for editorial excerpts, or invalid request session. Source withdrawal alone does not revoke owned personal captures.
rubric.defaultUnlisted: Every unlisted row is irrelevant to that specific request unless its request/lifecycle makes it forbidden. The independent reviewer must audit this default against the full authorized pool; a missing legitimate equivalent blocks freeze.
